outgoing.name: Henry David Thoreau
outgoing.excerpt: The river is perhaps best known for the early American literary classic A Week on the Concord and Merrimack River by Henry David Thoreau.

outgoing.name: Jack Kerouac
outgoing.excerpt: The Jack Kerouac book Doctor Sax is set during this event.

outgoing.name: United States
outgoing.excerpt: The Merrimack River (or Merrimac River, an earlier spelling that is sometimes still used) is a 110-mile-long (177-kilometer-long) river in the Northeastern United States.
